description_en: Queries the result of a watermark extraction task using the task ID that is returned when you create the task
description_zh: 根据创建提取任务时获取的任务ID，查询水印提取任务结果
name: GetWmExtractTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the extraction task. You can obtain the task ID by calling the [CreateWmExtractTask](~~CreateWmExtractTask~~) operation.

[CreateWmExtractTask](~~CreateWmExtractTask~~): Create a watermark extraction task
parameters.help_zh:
提取任务ID。取值来源：
[CreateWmExtractTask](~~CreateWmExtractTask~~)：创建水印提取任务
parameters.name: task_id

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created

Filename.description_en: The name of the file that was provided when the extraction task was created
Filename.description_zh: 创建提取任务时传入的文件名
Filename.title_en: 创建提取任务时传入的文件名
Filename.title_zh: 创建提取任务时传入的文件名

Status.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

Running: The task is running.

Success: The task is successful.

Failed: The task failed
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
Running：运行中。
Success：成功。
Failed：失败
Status.title_en:
任务状态
Running: 运行中
Success: 任务执行成功
Failed: 任务执行失败
Status.title_zh:
任务状态
Running: 运行中
Success: 任务执行成功
Failed: 任务执行失败

WmInfoBytesB64.description_en: The extracted watermark information as a Base64-encoded string
WmInfoBytesB64.description_zh: 提取得到的base64编码字符串格式的水印信息

WmInfoSize.description_en: The size of the watermark information, which was provided when the extraction task was created
WmInfoSize.description_zh: 创建提取任务时传入的参数
WmInfoSize.title_en: 创建提取任务时传入的参数
WmInfoSize.title_zh: 创建提取任务时传入的参数

WmInfoUint.description_en: The extracted watermark information in decimal format
WmInfoUint.description_zh: 提取得到的10进制数字格式的水印信息

WmType.description_en: The watermark type that was provided when the extraction task was created
WmType.description_zh: 创建提取任务时传入的水印类型
